response.text: The checkout container exits immediately because its CHECKOUT_PORT environment variable is not a port number. The newest Sandbox commit changed only that value.

structured.diagnosis: The checkout Deployment crash-loops because its CHECKOUT_PORT environment variable is set to not-a-port, which the service refuses when it starts listening. The newest Sandbox commit changed that value, so reverting the commit restores the known-good configuration.

findings.summary: The checkout container exited with a configuration error and its pod reports CrashLoopBackOff.
The newest Sandbox commit changed the checkout CHECKOUT_PORT value to not-a-port.
